This page is prepared for a future research group. It can grow into a home for students, alumni, project openings, and onboarding material.

## Mentoring Areas

- Semiconductor lifecycle intelligence and dependable computing
- Telemetry-driven digital twins
- Explainable anomaly detection and causal diagnosis
- Hardware/software co-design for edge AI
- AI for semiconductor manufacturing facilities

## Prospective Students

Future student projects will emphasize reproducible engineering research: strong problem framing, careful baselines, honest uncertainty, and artifacts that other researchers can build on.

## Lab Culture

The long-term goal is to build a group that combines rigorous systems thinking with practical AI methods for real semiconductor and engineering infrastructure problems.
